description: Build an SPF TXT record from the services and servers that send email for a domain, with an estimate of the DNS lookups it uses against SPF's limit of 10. Computes from the arguments only; nothing is looked up or stored.

a.description: The domain's own A record sends email.

hard_fail.description: End with -all instead of the usual ~all.

ip4.description: IPv4 addresses or ranges that send, like 192.0.2.10 or 192.0.2.0/24.

ip6.description: IPv6 addresses or ranges that send, like 2001:db8::/32.

mx.description: The domain's MX servers send email.

services.description: Email services that send for the domain; each adds its documented include.

name: generate_spf_record
title: Generate an SPF record
